overclaims: This federal report describes enforceable consumer-protection, credit, and employment protections applying to automated systems. It also identifies uncertainty and barriers to remedies, so existing legal authority does not establish comprehensive protection.
checks.note: The excerpt, proposition, conditions, rationale and outcome (causal_assessment / not_applicable / unresolved) all hold up. Two citation problems. The e1 excerpt 'No federal legislation' cuts off 'establishing broad regulatory authorities', so it reads as if there were no federal AI law at all. The e2 explanation says NTIA identifies 'barriers to remedies', but the retrieved text doesn't say that, and the payload's own limitation admits it doesn't.
